snippet.title: Skatesterre | Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Skatesterre will launch on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2 on August 13th.

Additionally, the official Skatesterre soundtrack is now available on Spotify. The playlist, filled to the brim with skate punk goodness, features underground bands and artists that set the perfect backdrop for flipping, grabbing and grinding. The new release date announcement trailer offers glimpses at all of the songs.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4224220/Skatesterre/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019221/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/skatesterre/9ngqgx3vfgkk
